items.text: Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.
Halloween string lights are now deployable again.
Modded servers are now correctly tagged and will no longer crash before fully starting.
Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

2026-10-02.summary:
### Sailing
- Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
- Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.

### Deployables
- Halloween string lights are now deployable again.

### Server & Stability
- Modded servers are now correctly tagged and will no longer crash before fully starting.

### World & Environment
- Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

items.text: Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.
Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.
Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.
Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.
Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.
The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.

2026-10-01.summary:
### Input & UI
- Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
- Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
- Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
- Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

### Livestock & Animals
- Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
- Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.

### Combat & Weapons
- Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
- Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.

### Structures & Interaction
- Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
- Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.

### DLC Content
- Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.

### Quality of Life
- The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.

items.text: Bread and brioche dung boost durations increased to 6 and 10 minutes respectively, making them more effective.
Animals now prioritize eating from a trough that provides a boost when food is present.
Purchased animals now spawn in front of the vendor instead of behind the player.
Minimum wool stack size for vendor reduced to 25 and maximum increased to 400; delivering 400 wool now grants top‑tier rewards.
Lootable train cars now correctly apply the softcore loot multiplier and yield double the items, enhancing loot returns.
Map cursor now shows a fixed center crosshair and allows adding/removing markers at that point.
Pump at the dome displays a countdown timer when the oil rig countdown is active.
Player teams, invites, and contacts are now saved correctly after server crashes; entities can opt out of the save cache.
Milky Healing Tea now heals up to 112 health (capped at 100 pending health), increasing its effectiveness.
Hole depth is now correctly cleared during hole passes, fixing terrain inconsistencies.
Fix local client player being destroyed during scene switches and allow reloadmap without errors.
Correct invalid isLoading state after map reload, restoring camera control.
Prevent RustNavigation null reference errors on reload and preserve server scene, fixing camera detachment.
Reduce food required for livestock, easing feeding.
Add halters to all livestock and improve rope mechanics, giving adult animals proper leading ropes.
Vendor now informs you of required wool amount when you lack enough to sell.
Prevent wild livestock from dying due to hunger or unmet needs, capping health at 50%.
Stop wild livestock from passive taming and uncontrolled breeding.
Introduce taming decay for livestock without full bond, block sleepers from passive taming, and give calves a modest familiarity bonus.
Fix calf purchase dialogue to correctly require sufficient scrap.
Boombox activation now counts toward team objective progress for all members present in the same underwater lab.
Motorcycles and bicycles now dismount to the side instead of the top, fixing mount point ordering.
Resolve rare duplication of crates in oil rig puzzle rooms after server crashes by invalidating puzzle generator cache.
Fix pooling bugs that caused crabs and jellyfish to appear invisible, restoring their visibility.
Fixed animals not eating from troughs and prevented cows from dying of hunger in properly set up farms.
Fixed featured tab showing duplicate items in the store UI.
Boost foods (bread and brioche dung) now last 6 or 10 minutes and animals prioritize troughs that contain these foods.
Livestock now require less food; wild animals no longer die from hunger and health loss is capped at 50%.
Passive taming and uncontrolled breeding of wild livestock have been disabled; taming decays without a full bond, sleepers cannot be passively tamed, and calves receive a modest familiarity bonus.
Purchased animals always spawn in front of the vendor, and animals can now eat from troughs, preventing hunger deaths.
Wool vendor stack limits changed to a minimum of 25 and a maximum of 400, with delivering 400 wool granting top‑tier rewards.
Trainyard loot cars now correctly apply the softcore loot multiplier and double the amount of items found, increasing loot yields.
Milky Healing Tea now restores up to 112 health (previously capped at 100).
A new map cursor with fixed center crosshairs lets players add or remove map markers at the cursor position.
A visible countdown timer appears on the dome pump while the oil rig countdown is active, showing pump availability.
Livestock vendor UI now correctly validates scrap when purchasing calves and warns players when they try to sell more wool than they have.
Player teams, invites, and contacts are preserved after server crashes, and entities can opt out of the save cache to protect relationship data.

Fixed several crash‑inducing bugs: player destruction during scene switches, invalid loading state after map reload, and navigation null‑reference errors, restoring camera control and preventing crashes.
Crabs and jellyfish invisibility pooling bugs have been fixed, and vehicle dismount now uses side points to avoid placing players on top of motorcycles or bicycles.
Crate duplication in oil rig puzzle rooms after a server crash is prevented by clearing the puzzle generator’s network cache on reset.
Terrain holes now correctly clear depth during passes, preventing lingering terrain artifacts that could affect building foundations.
Medieval doors are now counted as closed for base occlusion, improving base security calculations.
Adult livestock now use two ropes like horses, fixing rope behavior and keeping rope ends off‑camera.
Activating a boombox in the underwater labs mission now counts toward each team member's objective progress when they are in the same lab.

- Fixed several crash‑inducing bugs: player destruction during scene switches, invalid loading state after map reload, and navigation null‑reference errors, restoring camera control and preventing crashes.
- Crabs and jellyfish invisibility pooling bugs have been fixed, and vehicle dismount now uses side points to avoid placing players on top of motorcycles or bicycles.
